# Nomura Careers

> > Nomura's global careers portal connecting talent with opportunities across investment banking, global markets, wealth management, and technology roles worldwide.

Nomura Careers is the primary recruitment hub for Nomura Holdings, Inc., a leading global financial services firm. The portal features job openings across multiple business divisions and geographic locations, with particular strength in Asia-Pacific markets like Mumbai, Singapore, and Hong Kong.

## Key Topics

- Global Markets
- Investment Banking
- Wealth Management
- Investment Management
- Wholesale Banking
- Risk Management
- Software Engineering
- Data Governance
- Infrastructure Operations
- Mumbai
- Singapore
- London
- Associate-level roles
- Senior roles
- Nomura Holdings

## Featured Opportunities

- [Careers | Instinet](https://careers.nomura.com/Instinet): Nomura and Instinet careers job search and recruitment portal
